# 🔥 VEJA DO QUE O META QUEST 3 É REALMENTE CAPAZ 🔥

**PEGUE. ESCANEIE. HACKEIE. VOE. LUTE.**

🏆 **D.I.C.E.: Immersive Reality Game of the Year + Immersive Reality Technical Achievement**

Em **Red Matter 2**, seus controles viram multiferramentas de ficção científica. Pegue, escaneie, traduza, hackeie, lute e voe por mundos de baixa gravidade.

Quase tudo que parece interativo realmente é. Sem HUD flutuante e sem “aperte X”. Ferramentas, controles e inventário pertencem ao mundo.

Siga o sinal de socorro de um amigo desaparecido. Como o agente Sasha Riss, infiltre-se em instalações volgravianas e revele a conspiração que distorce a realidade por trás do Red Matter.

## FERRAMENTAS QUE EXISTEM NO MUNDO

- 🦾 **Pegar e manipular:** Opere máquinas, redirecione energia e resolva puzzles.
- 🔎 **Escanear e traduzir:** Examine objetos em busca de pistas.
- 🔌 **Hackear sistemas:** Rompa a segurança e abra novos caminhos.
- 🔦 **Iluminar o desconhecido:** Use a lanterna ou dispare sinalizadores.
- ⚡ **Adaptar seu arsenal:** Transforme a ferramenta para puzzles e combates.
- 🚀 **Dominar o jetpack:** Atravesse paisagens de baixa gravidade.

## OTIMIZADO PARA META QUEST 3

Veja resolução mais alta, sombras dinâmicas e texturas aprimoradas, das máquinas aos anéis de Saturno.

*Novo na série? Não é preciso ter jogado o primeiro **Red Matter**.*

**Responda ao sinal. Opere o impossível. Enfrente o Red Matter.**
nodes.short_description: Seus controles viram multiferramentas de ficção científica em uma aventura de VR premiada onde quase tudo pode ser tocado. Pegue, escaneie, hackeie, voe e lute por um sistema solar distópico para revelar o segredo do Red Matter.

nodes.long_description:
# 🔥 SCOPRI COSA PUÒ FARE DAVVERO META QUEST 3 🔥

**AFFERRA. SCANSIONA. VIOLA. VOLA. COMBATTI.**

🏆 **D.I.C.E.: Immersive Reality Game of the Year + Immersive Reality Technical Achievement**

In **Red Matter 2**, i controller diventano multi-strumenti fantascientifici. Afferra, scansiona, traduci, viola sistemi, combatti e vola a bassa gravità.

Quasi tutto ciò che sembra interattivo lo è davvero. Niente HUD fluttuante e niente “premi X”. Strumenti, comandi e inventario appartengono al mondo di gioco.

Segui il segnale di un amico scomparso. Nei panni dell’agente Sasha Riss, infiltrati nelle strutture volgraviane e svela la cospirazione che altera la realtà dietro il Red Matter.

## STRUMENTI CHE ESISTONO NEL MONDO

- 🦾 **Afferra e manipola:** Aziona macchinari, devia energia e risolvi enigmi.
- 🔎 **Scansiona e traduci:** Esamina gli oggetti e trova indizi.
- 🔌 **Viola i sistemi:** Supera la sicurezza e apri nuovi percorsi.
- 🔦 **Illumina l’ignoto:** Usa la torcia o i razzi illuminanti.
- ⚡ **Adatta l’arsenale:** Trasforma lo strumento per enigmi e scontri.
- 🚀 **Domina il jetpack:** Supera paesaggi a bassa gravità.

## OTTIMIZZATO PER META QUEST 3

Scopri alta risoluzione, ombre dinamiche e texture migliorate, dai macchinari agli anelli di Saturno.

*È la tua prima volta nella serie? Non serve aver giocato al primo **Red Matter**.*

**Rispondi al segnale. Aziona l’impossibile. Affronta il Red Matter.**
nodes.short_description: I controller diventano multi-strumenti fantascientifici in un’avventura VR pluripremiata dove quasi tutto si può toccare. Afferra, scansiona, viola sistemi, vola e combatti in un sistema solare distopico per svelare il segreto del Red Matter.

nodes.long_description:
# 🔥 META QUEST 3의 진정한 성능을 경험하세요 🔥

**잡고. 스캔하고. 해킹하고. 날고. 싸우세요.**

🏆 **D.I.C.E.: Immersive Reality Game of the Year + Immersive Reality Technical Achievement**

**Red Matter 2**에서 컨트롤러는 SF 멀티툴로 변합니다. 물체를 잡고, 스캔하고, 번역하고, 시스템을 해킹하고, 어둠을 밝히고, 싸우며 저중력 세계를 날아다니세요.

상호작용할 수 있어 보이는 것은 거의 모두 실제로 조작할 수 있습니다. 떠다니는 HUD도, “X를 눌러 상호작용”도 없습니다. 도구와 조작 장치, 인벤토리가 모두 세계 안에 존재합니다.

실종된 친구의 구조 신호를 따라 디스토피아 태양계를 횡단하세요. 요원 사샤 리스가 되어 볼그라비아 시설에 잠입하고, 레드 매터 뒤에 숨은 현실을 뒤트는 음모를 밝혀내세요.

## 세계 안에 존재하는 도구

- 🦾 **잡고 조작하기:** 기계를 작동하고, 전력을 전환하고, 물리 퍼즐을 푸세요.
- 🔎 **스캔과 번역:** 사물을 조사해 단서와 번역을 찾으세요.
- 🔌 **시스템 해킹:** 보안을 뚫고 새로운 길을 여세요.
- 🔦 **미지 밝히기:** 손전등이나 조명탄으로 어둠을 밝히세요.
- ⚡ **무기 변형:** 퍼즐과 전투에 맞게 도구를 바꾸세요.
- 🚀 **제트팩 숙련:** 저중력 협곡과 지형을 건너세요.

## META QUEST 3 최적화

고해상도 렌더링, 동적 그림자, 향상된 텍스처로 정교한 기계부터 토성의 고리까지 선명하게 경험하세요.

*시리즈가 처음이어도 괜찮습니다. 전작 **Red Matter**를 플레이할 필요가 없습니다.*

**신호에 응답하세요. 불가능을 조작하세요. 레드 매터와 마주하세요.**
nodes.short_description: 컨트롤러가 SF 멀티툴로 변하는 수상 경력의 VR 어드벤처. 거의 모든 것을 만질 수 있는 세계에서 잡고, 스캔하고, 해킹하고, 날고, 싸우며 디스토피아 태양계에 숨겨진 레드 매터의 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

nodes.long_description:
# 🔥 见证 META QUEST 3 的真正实力 🔥

**抓取。扫描。破解。飞行。战斗。**

🏆 **D.I.C.E.: Immersive Reality Game of the Year + Immersive Reality Technical Achievement**

在 **Red Matter 2** 中，控制器将化身科幻多功能工具。抓取、扫描、翻译、破解、照亮黑暗、投入战斗，在低重力世界中自由飞行。

看似可以互动的物体，几乎都能实际操作。没有悬浮HUD，也没有“按X互动”。工具、控制装置和物品栏都真实存在于游戏世界中。

追寻失踪好友的求救信号，穿越反乌托邦太阳系。化身特工萨莎·里斯，潜入沃尔格拉维亚设施，揭开红色物质背后扭曲现实的阴谋。

## 存在于世界中的工具

- 🦾 **抓取与操控：** 操作机械、切换能源并破解物理谜题。
- 🔎 **扫描与翻译：** 检查物体，寻找线索和译文。
- 🔌 **破解系统：** 突破安保，开启新道路。
- 🔦 **照亮未知：** 使用手电筒或发射照明弹。
- ⚡ **改变武装：** 根据解谜和战斗需要变换工具。
- 🚀 **掌握喷气背包：** 飞越低重力峡谷与地貌。

## META QUEST 3 专属优化

以更高分辨率、动态阴影和增强纹理，呈现精密机械乃至土星光环。

*第一次接触本系列？无需玩过前作 **Red Matter**。*

**回应信号。驾驭不可能。直面红色物质。**
nodes.short_description: 在这款屡获殊荣的VR冒险游戏中，控制器将化身科幻多功能工具，几乎所有物体都可触碰互动。抓取、扫描、破解、飞行、战斗，穿越反乌托邦太阳系，揭开扭曲现实的“红色物质”之谜。

nodes.long_description:
# 🔥 META QUEST 3の真価を体感せよ 🔥

**つかむ。スキャン。ハッキング。飛ぶ。戦う。**

🏆 **D.I.C.E.: Immersive Reality Game of the Year + Immersive Reality Technical Achievement**

**Red Matter 2**では、コントローラーがSFマルチツールへと変わる。物をつかみ、スキャンして翻訳し、端末をハッキングし、闇を照らし、戦い、低重力の世界を飛び回れ。

触れられそうに見えるものは、ほぼすべて操作可能。宙に浮くHUDも「Xを押して操作」もない。ツール、操作装置、インベントリのすべてが世界の中に存在する。

行方不明の友から届いた救難信号を追い、ディストピア化した太陽系へ。エージェント、サーシャ・リスとしてヴォルグラヴィアの施設に潜入し、レッドマターを巡る現実を歪める陰謀を暴け。

## 世界の中に存在するツール

- 🦾 **つかんで操作：** 機械を動かし、電力をつなぎ替え、物理パズルを解く。
- 🔎 **スキャンと翻訳：** 物を調べ、手掛かりや翻訳を見つける。
- 🔌 **システム侵入：** セキュリティを突破し、新たな道を開く。
- 🔦 **未知を照らす：** ライトや照明弾で闇を照らす。
- ⚡ **武装を変形：** ツールをパズルや戦闘に適応させる。
- 🚀 **ジェットパック：** 低重力の峡谷や地形を飛び越える。

## META QUEST 3向け最適化

高解像度レンダリング、ダイナミックシャドウ、強化されたテクスチャで、精巧な機械から土星の環まで鮮明に描写。

*シリーズ初体験でも問題なし。前作**Red Matter**の知識は不要です。*

**信号に応え、不可能を操り、レッドマターに立ち向かえ。**
nodes.short_description: コントローラーがSFマルチツールへと変わる、受賞歴を誇るVRアドベンチャー。ほぼすべてに触れられる世界で、つかむ、スキャン、ハッキング、飛行、戦闘を駆使し、ディストピア化した太陽系に隠されたレッドマターの秘密を暴け。

nodes.long_description:
# 🔥 DÉCOUVREZ CE DONT META QUEST 3 EST CAPABLE 🔥

**SAISISSEZ. SCANNEZ. PIRATEZ. VOLEZ. COMBATTEZ.**

🏆 **D.I.C.E. : Immersive Reality Game of the Year + Immersive Reality Technical Achievement**

Dans **Red Matter 2**, vos manettes deviennent des multi-outils de science-fiction. Saisissez, scannez, traduisez, piratez, combattez et volez en faible gravité.

Presque tout ce qui semble interactif l’est. Pas d’interface flottante ni de « pressez X ». Outils, commandes et inventaire appartiennent au monde.

Suivez le signal d’un ami disparu à travers un système solaire dystopique. Incarnez l’agent Sasha Riss, infiltrez des installations volgraviennes et dévoilez la conspiration qui déforme la réalité derrière le Red Matter.

## DES OUTILS DANS LE MONDE

- 🦾 **Saisir et manipuler :** Machines, énergie et énigmes physiques.
- 🔎 **Scanner et traduire :** Trouvez indices et traductions.
- 🔌 **Pirater :** Forcez la sécurité et ouvrez de nouveaux passages.
- 🔦 **Éclairer l’inconnu :** Lampe et fusées éclairantes.
- ⚡ **Adapter votre arsenal :** Transformez votre outil selon la situation.
- 🚀 **Maîtriser le jetpack :** Franchissez les paysages en faible gravité.

## OPTIMISÉ POUR META QUEST 3

Profitez d’un rendu haute résolution, d’ombres dynamiques et de textures enrichies, des machines jusqu’aux anneaux de Saturne.

*Vous découvrez la série ? Il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir joué au premier **Red Matter**.*

**Répondez au signal. Maniez l’impossible. Affrontez le Red Matter.**
nodes.short_description: Vos manettes deviennent des multi-outils de science-fiction dans une aventure VR primée où presque tout peut être touché. Saisissez, scannez, piratez, volez et combattez à travers un système solaire dystopique pour percer le secret du Red Matter.

nodes.long_description:
# 🔥 ERLEBE, WAS META QUEST 3 WIRKLICH KANN 🔥

**GREIFEN. SCANNEN. HACKEN. FLIEGEN. KÄMPFEN.**

🏆 **D.I.C.E.: Immersive Reality Game of the Year + Immersive Reality Technical Achievement**

In **Red Matter 2** werden deine Controller zu Sci-Fi-Multitools. Greife, scanne, übersetze, hacke, kämpfe und fliege durch Welten mit geringer Schwerkraft.

Fast alles, was interaktiv aussieht, ist es auch. Kein schwebendes HUD, kein „Drücke X“. Werkzeuge, Steuerung und Inventar sind Teil der Spielwelt.

Folge dem Notsignal eines verschollenen Freundes. Infiltriere als Agent Sasha Riss volgravianische Anlagen und decke die realitätsverzerrende Verschwörung hinter der Roten Materie auf.

## WERKZEUGE IN DER SPIELWELT

- 🦾 **Greifen & bewegen:** Maschinen bedienen, Energie umleiten, Rätsel lösen.
- 🔎 **Scannen & übersetzen:** Objekte auf Hinweise untersuchen.
- 🔌 **Systeme hacken:** Sicherheit umgehen und Wege öffnen.
- 🔦 **Dunkelheit erhellen:** Taschenlampe oder Leuchtraketen nutzen.
- ⚡ **Arsenal anpassen:** Werkzeug für Rätsel und Kämpfe verwandeln.
- 🚀 **Jetpack meistern:** Schluchten bei geringer Schwerkraft überqueren.

## OPTIMIERT FÜR META QUEST 3

Erlebe höhere Auflösung, dynamische Schatten und verbesserte Texturen – von Maschinen bis zu Saturns Ringen.

*Neu bei Red Matter? Vorkenntnisse aus dem ersten **Red Matter** sind nicht nötig.*

**Beantworte das Signal. Bediene das Unmögliche. Stelle dich der Roten Materie.**
nodes.short_description: Deine Controller werden zu Sci-Fi-Multitools in einem preisgekrönten VR-Abenteuer, in dem fast alles berührbar ist. Greife, scanne, hacke, fliege und kämpfe durch ein dystopisches Sonnensystem, um das realitätsverzerrende Geheimnis der Roten Materie zu lüften.

Disfruta de mayor resolución, sombras dinámicas y texturas mejoradas, desde la maquinaria hasta los anillos de Saturno.

# 🔥 SEE WHAT META QUEST 3 CAN REALLY DO 🔥

**GRAB. SCAN. HACK. FLY. FIGHT.**

🏆 **D.I.C.E.: Immersive Reality Game of the Year + Immersive Reality Technical Achievement**

In **Red Matter 2**, your controllers become sci-fi multi-tools. Grab, scan, translate, hack, light the dark, fight, and fly across low-gravity worlds.

Nearly everything that looks interactive actually is. No floating HUD. No “press X to interact.” Your tools, controls, and inventory belong to the world.

Follow a lost friend’s distress signal across a dystopian solar system. As Agent Sasha Riss, infiltrate Volgravian facilities and uncover the reality-bending conspiracy behind the Red Matter.

## TOOLS THAT EXIST INSIDE THE WORLD

- 🦾 **Grab & manipulate:** Operate machinery, reroute power, and solve physical puzzles.
- 🔎 **Scan & translate:** Examine objects for clues and translations.
- 🔌 **Hack systems:** Breach security and open new paths.
- 🔦 **Light the unknown:** Use your flashlight or fire flares.
- ⚡ **Adapt your arsenal:** Transform your tool for puzzles and combat.
- 🚀 **Master the jetpack:** Cross low-gravity chasms and alien landscapes.

## OPTIMIZED FOR META QUEST 3

Experience higher-resolution rendering, dynamic shadows, and enhanced textures—from intricate machinery to Saturn’s rings.

*New to the series? No previous experience with the original **Red Matter** is required.*

**Answer the signal. Operate the impossible. Face the Red Matter.**
nodes.short_description: Your controllers become sci-fi multi-tools in an award-winning VR adventure where nearly everything can be touched. Grab, scan, hack, fly and fight across a dystopian solar system to uncover the reality-bending secret of the Red Matter.

nodes.long_description:
After breaking free from the simulation that held your own mind hostage, your first priority is to escape the Atlantic Union’s base. However, you unexpectedly discover a distress signal belonging to an old friend. Determined to come to his rescue, you will travel to the farthest reaches of the solar system to find him. During your journey you will unveil Volgravia's darkest secrets and confront the unstoppable Red Matter. 

Red Matter 2 introduces new mechanics to expand the existing gameplay into the adventure genre. Not only will you face brand new and challenging puzzles, but thanks to a new jetpack you will be able to traverse the game’s environments more freely than ever before through platforming sections. A new tool has been added to the classic loadout that will enable you to hack terminals, as well as a weapon that will prove useful in various environmental puzzles and come well in handy when dealing with certain ‘surprises’ that you’re sure to face during your adventures.

nodes.change_log:
Quest 3 Enhancements:
- Screen Resolution Upgrade: Dynamic resolution now allows for an upper limit of 3322x3519, a significant increase from the fixed 1226x1440 on Quest 2.
- 4K Textures: Leveraging Quest 3's enhanced memory, textures have been upgraded to console quality, boasting up to a 16x increase in pixel count.
- Anisotropic Filtering: On-screen textures now benefit from Aniso 8x, enhancing sharpness dramatically.
- Dynamic Shadows: Spotlights now cast dynamic shadows, adding a layer of realism to the scene.
- PCF5x5 Shadow Filtering: Selected surfaces showcase console-quality shadow filtering, producing softer and more lifelike shadows.
- Mesh LOD Improvements: Enhanced graphics reduce LOD popping, ensuring a more cohesive visual experience.
- Frame Rate Adaptability: During combat, Quest 3 will dynamically adjust frame rates from 72 fps to 90 fps.

Quest 2 Enhancements:
- Dynamic Resolution: Quest 2 now supports dynamic resolution, enhancing visual clarity.

General Updates:
- Achievements: Players can now unlock achievements throughout the game.
